surat.headline: Surat cluster faces input cost spikes and labor friction alongside sporadic diamond demand pockets
what_changed: Surat loom and textile units faced early closure threats and shutdown risks driven by severe yarn price hikes up to 66% [b567711c9ed4, b62552cc0c7d].
Labor unrest and wage protests intensified, leading to worker detentions, union leader bookings, and migrant worker exodus [7697e96a190e, 9d4f02830710, d6a4b0e6a74b].
Diamond exports dropped by 7%, while the diamond industry shortened its Diwali vacation duration amid localized demand improvements [975918f112f3, 2b47ff4fa01a].
stress_signals: Surat embroidery sector impasse continues for three months, disrupting job-work processing and cash velocity [e7921383cbb7].

Multiple cheating, fraud, and default cases emerged across yarn, fabric, and diamond sectors, including a ₹10.14 crore textile fraud case and ₹62 crore in viscose weaver defaults [2514ad7d6e20, a70c9ae52e8d, 2718cba9f837].
Boiler blast and fire at an Udhna textile unit resulted in six injuries [691b478fe424].
improvement_signals: GST Council granted Input Tax Credit (ITC) refunds and eased highway checks for Surat textiles [17f0a015a73c].
Surat diamond industry shortened its traditional Diwali vacation for the first time in four years due to improved demand [2b47ff4fa01a].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital limits and inventory holding costs of upstream weaving units affected by extreme yarn price surges.
Track labor union negotiations regarding wages, holidays, and 8-hour workdays to prevent prolonged operational shutdowns.
Verify repayment track records and debtor-creditor reconciliation for accounts exposed to grey fabric and viscose trading defaults.
